Document.title: Document
Document.description: A document uploaded by the user for analysis.

name.description: The original filename of the document.

type.description: The MIME type of the document.

content.description: The base64 encoded content of the document.

userId.description: The UID of the user who uploaded the document.

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the document was created.

Analysis.title: Analysis
Analysis.description: An AI analysis result for a specific document.

documentId.description: The ID of the document this analysis belongs to.

agentType.description: The type of agent that performed the analysis.

result.description: The markdown result of the analysis.

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this analysis.

createdAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the analysis was created.
